Commentary.Commentary: That brings New Zealand's tour of India to an end. The Kiwis have entertained for sure but India proved too good in the end. Hope you enjoyed our coverage. NZ are flying back home to host Pakistan next month while India will see England coming over soon. Lots of cricketing action. Do join us for all that. For now, it's goodbye from us.

MS DHONI feels that it was one of the best performances by the bowlers. Says that it was the first game in the series when his spinners got to bowl with the surface assisting them as they had chased in all the games before. Feels that the dew didn't quite come and lauds his spinners for doing really well. Praises Mishra especially for his performance and also had words of encouragement for Axar as well. Feels that his batsmen did a good job, particularly Rohit and Kohli. Says that it was important to assess the conditions and feels his team did it well as they scored about 20 runs more than the par score. Says that he is happy with the performance of the team throughout the series despite resting several key players. Feels that the youngsters need to get continued exposure so that they can make it big in future.

KANE WILLIAMSON feels that the target was well above-par as far as the pitch was concerned. States that India played better cricket throughout and deserved to win the series. Expresses disappointment at NZ's batting failure today and is unable to point out a reason behind the meek surrender. Feels that the whole tour has been a good learning curve for his side in tough conditions against a formidable opponent. Hopes that his side can learn from these experiences. Says that there have been many positives on the tour. Singles out Latham and Santner for their maturity. Hopes that the whole group can learn and improve in the upcoming matches.

AMIT MISHRA (MAN OF THE MATCH AND SERIES) says that he is happy to contribute to the team's victory. He states that team's victory gives him the most joy. Adds that he had the full backing of skipper Dhoni. Feels that there was spin and inconsistent bounce in the pitch, so he was trying to flight the ball more. Praises Axar for doing well throughout the series and opines that their partnership has been good. Hopes that they can keep it doing. Credits his teammates and coaches for the success. Ends by saying that he hopes he can keep the good work going.

With the ball turning and gripping, India's spinners were on a roll after Umesh and Bumrah had provided the perfect start with a wicket apiece. Mishra ripped through the batting with a 5-fer as the Kiwis had no idea to counter his spin variations. Axar and debutant Jayant too gave able support as New Zealand were ambushed by spin. Earlier in the day, fifties from Rohit and Kohli were the highlight of India's innings as they posted a competitive total. Dhoni and Jadhav too chipped in with the latter's knock ensuring India got past the 260-run mark. In the end, it was a no-contest.

India have decimated the Kiwis to win their first bilateral ODI series against a top-eight side since November 2014. Chasing a tricky target of 270 on a dicey surface assisting spin, the Kiwis were never in the hunt as they couldn't adapt to the turning ball at all. Only Latham, Williamson and Taylor managed to cross double digits and that pretty much tells you the story of their innings. It was a surprisingly meek capitulation, considering how competent they had been right from the Tests, even in defeat. This is also NZ's lowest ODI score against India.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Demolition completed. Darted on middle, turns in a bit with very low bounce as Santner looks to play back to that one. Misses the line and the ball goes under his bat to crash into the sticks. That completes a huge rout. INDIA WIN BY 190 RUNS TO SEAL THE SERIES 3-2.
AXAR PATEL is back on.
Tossed up fuller outside off, Boult presses forward and defends it well.
A bit short and outside off, punched off the back foot to deep point for a single.
Quicker ball outside off, MS gets back and jabs it to cover.
Flatter on middle, makes room and jams it towards short cover.
Full and outside off, steps out and wrists it to short mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Floated leg break outside off, Boult nudges it towards the slip region.
TRENT BOULT is last man in.

OUT! 5-FER FOR MISHRA! What a spell this has been! Floated leg break outside off and Sodhi goes for the slog sweep. Gets a top edge that goes straight up in the air. Rahane at first slip runs to the leg slip region to take the skier with ease. India are just a wicket away now as the celebrations start in the stands. The party had started for quite some time now.
Drifting in on a length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the covers.
Loopy leg break on leg stump, spins away as Sodhi smothers it to the ground.
Tossed up outside off, blocked well off the front foot to the covers.
A bit short and outside off, crashed off the back foot to short cover. Kohli's throw is a touch off-target but Mishra backs up brilliantly.
Drifting in on middle, defended well from the crease down the track.
Flatter on middle, too close to cut but Santner goes through with the shot. Chops it down to third man for a brace.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Floated off break outside off, Santner is beaten on the poke.
Fuller outside off, blocked well from the crease.
ISH SODHI comes out to bat.

OUT! DHONI IS RIGHT AS USUAL! Floated leg break outside off, Southee goes for a big drive but misses as MS whips off the bails in a flash. They want to refer it upstairs. The Indian captain is confident. Replays show that Southee's foot was momentarily up in the air and that was enough for Dhoni.
Appeal for a stumping upstairs against Southee. Dhoni is confident and when that's the case, it's usually a bad sign for the batsman. Let's see.
Slider on leg stump, Southee looks to block but gets an inside half to the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, Southee defends it well towards cover.
Fuller on leg stump, Southee is rapped on the front pad.
TIM SOUTHEE is the new man in.

OUT! GOT HIM! What a ball! Spin is bamboozling NZ comprehensively at the moment. 'A deadly leg spinner' according to my colleague that pitches well outside off. Spins in a mile to go between bat and pad as Neesham looks to block. The ball disturbs the timber and the Indians are elated all over. India are just 3 wickets away from a series victory.
MITCHELL SANTNER is the new man in.

OUT! MAIDEN ODI SCALP FOR JAYANT! Slider on middle, Anderson has a brainfade as he looks to block but his bat seemed to have jammed close to the pad. The ball skids off the deck to rap him on the front pad. That was dead plumb and an easy call for the umpire. Wickets continue to tumble here in Vizag.
Fuller on middle and off, Neesham gets across and eases it to mid on for a single.
DROPPED! A sharp chance though! A bit short and outside off, Neesham flashes the cut but gets a thick edge that Rahane spills at first slip. Difficult chance and so can't really blame Jinx there.
Floated outside off, Neesham hangs back and blocks it out.
Loopy on a length outside off, blocked well off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller and outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Five Wides! The leg break spins way down the leg side. Goes right between the keeper and leg slip to the fence.
Full and outside off, Anderson goes across to flick but gets a leading edge to the off side.
Fuller outside off, blocked off the front foot to the off side.
Fuller on middle and off, Anderson gets another inside edge this time to leg slip.
Drifting in on middle, spins in as Anderson gets an inside edge to the leg side.
Floated leg break outside off, spins back to rap the front pad. Lbw appeal but the impact saves Neesham.
Flighted on off, very full and Neesham manages to dig out.
Tossed up just outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Full and on leg stump, worked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Floated on off, Neesham presses forward and defends it well.
Drifting away outside off, Neesham hangs back to block but gets a bottom edge on to the track.
Floated around off, defended well off the front foot on to the track.
The debutant JAYANT YADAV comes on to bowl.
COREY ANDERSON is the new man in.
Drinks break and already New Zealand's chase has been derailed. It'll take a miracle from here for them to compete in this chase.

OUT! RIPPER FROM MISHRA! The wrong 'un just outside off, Watling has no clue to that one as he looks to drive loosely at it. The ball sneaks between bat and pad to disturb the timber. The Indians are all over the Kiwis at the moment in this decider. Half the batsmen are back in the hut for NZ.
Flatter outside off, Watling defends it well from the crease.
BJ WATLING is the new man in.

OUT! ANOTHER BIG STRIKE! Floated on a length outside off, spinning away a bit as Taylor shapes for the cut. Gets a feather due to the extra bounce that is snapped up by Dhoni who is excited straightaway and starts to appeal. The umpires want to check the no ball and Mishra just about escapes. So, NZ continue to falter in this chase as they lose another senior batsman.
Taylor has been given out caught behind. They are checking for the no ball.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot to the off side.
On a length and spinning away from outside off, Taylor plays the late dab to the right of Rahane at short third man. Goes to the deep as they take a brace.
Tossed up around off, driven firmly towards the covers.
Loopy on a length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
JIMMY NEESHAM is the new man in.

OUT! MASSIVE STRIKE! Tossed up gently around off, Williamson looks to play the inside out lofted drive but miscues it high towards long off. The ball was dipping on Jadhav who took a sharp catch in the deep. This is a body blow to New Zealand. Is it the game for India? The chase continues to get more difficult for the Kiwis.
Speared in on middle, KW hangs back and just manages to dab it towards point.
Slider on off, kept low and Taylor just manages to jam it towards the short cover region. Quick single taken.
Flatter on off, pushed off the back foot to the bowler.
Tossed up well outside off, Taylor jabs it to cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, Taylor gets forward and pushes it to cover.
Quicker ball outside off, KW gets back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Flighted outside off, Taylor reaches out and pushes it to cover-point. Single taken.
Flatter on leg stump, tucked to short fine leg where Bumrah fumbles as the batsmen get a single.
Leg break outside off, Taylor hangs back and cuts it late to short third man for a single.
Flatter outside off, Williamson blocks it firmly off the back foot.
Fuller on middle, worked away gently towards the mid-wicket region.
FOUR! NICELY DONE! Darted in around off, Williamson plays a risky cut against the angle and gets it past a diving Kohli at point. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
A bit short outside off, Williamson goes back to cut towards point.
Drifting away from outside off, KW pushes it gently towards cover.
Slider on off, KW looks to block it off the front foot but gets it off the inside half.
Flatter on off, Williamson goes back and works it to long on for a single.
Slider outside off, Taylor gets back and jabs it to point.
Quicker ball outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
That was close! Floated outside off, Williamson goes back for the drive and miscues it in the air just past extra cover. The ball goes to the left of long off for a single.
A bit short and outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
A bit short outside off, cut away towards deep point for a brace.
AMIT MISHRA comes on to bowl.
Flighted outside off, Williamson presses forward and defends it well.
On a length around off, Williamson goes back to cut but chops it to point.
Floated outside off, Taylor eases the drive down to long off for one.
Flighted on off, Taylor drives it firmly back to the bowler.
Darted in around off, pushed gently towards the off side from the crease.
PEACH! Fired in outside off, spins away a mile to beat the outside edge comfortably. Taylor was clueless.
Fuller on off, Williamson gets across and drives it to mid on.

Another life for Williamson! Fuller on middle, worked towards square leg where Axar makes a good stop. Taylor and Kane have a big mix up but Patel's throw at the keeper's end is wayward. Single taken.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Short and outside off, Taylor gets width to free his arms and flashes the cut through the off side. That rocketed through the infield to the fence in a jiffy.
Length ball outside off, blocked off the back foot to point.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson steered it down to third man for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Flatter outside off, Ross goes back and cuts it to the off side.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.

RUN OUT MISSED! Brilliant from Virat. Fuller outside off, Williamson pushes it to the covers where Kohli makes a brilliant diving stop. He throws it off balance at the bowler's end but the throw is wild. Axar wasn't quite alert to judge the throw as he could have moved across to collect and still affect the run out as Kane was way short.
Slider outside off, Taylor cuts again and this time finds a diving Mandeep at backward point. Single taken.
Floated outside off, Taylor goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge on to the track.
AXAR PATEL comes on to bowl.
Good length outside off, pushed off the back foot to the bowler.
Length ball outside off, blocked well off the front foot to cover.
Good length outside off, steered it down to third man for a single.
Full and angled in around off, Taylor chops it towards short mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, pushed gently towards the covers.
Full and angled in on middle stump, Taylor gets across and pushes it towards mid on.

FOUR! MORE RUNS! Short and wide this time from Umesh and Williamson responds with a fierce cut through cover-point. Struck it really well and in the gap to find the fence. Productive over for the Kiwis.

FOUR! ANOTHER QUALITY SHOT! Overpitched ball outside off, Williamson reaches out and creams it through extra cover. Timing is the key again as the ball rockets to the fence. The NZ captain is looking ominous at the moment.
Pitched up on off, Williamson gets across and drives it back to the bowler.
Wide! Full and very wide outside off, swinging further away as Williamson chases it. Fails to put bat on ball. Wide signalled.
Length ball outside off, Williamson steers it towards point.
Fuller just outside off, KW presses forward and blocks it out.
Good length just around off, angling in as Williamson makes a good leave. That wasn't far away from the off stump.

OUT! BUMRAH STRIKES! It's a big one too as the in-form Latham has to depart. Length ball angled in on off, Tom looks to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge that bobbles to mid on where the debutant Jayant takes an easy catch. NZ in a bit of trouble early in the run chase.
Short of a length outside off, blocked off the back foot on to the track.
Full and on off, Latham gets across and pushes it towards the leg side.
Fuller outside off, Williamson eases it to cover for a quick single.
Length ball outside off, Kane looks to run it down to third man but gets the edge towards first slip on the bounce.
Length ball outside off, KW reaches out and dabs it with soft hands to the gully region.
Hammer is out to level out the spots near the bowler's landing area.
Full and just around off, Latham looks to block with his bat behind the pad and misses. Pinged on the front pad and there is a big lbw appeal. Impact probably saved Latham.

FOUR! PURE CLASS! Full ball outside off, Latham leans into it and creams it through the covers. Timed it sweetly once again and just placed it in the gap in the covers to find another boundary. He's looking in top touch.
Pitched up outside off, Latham gets forward and eases it to short extra cover.
Length ball angled in from outside off, Latham hangs back and punches it towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.

FOUR! BREAD AND BUTTER FOR LATHAM! Drifting on the pads and Tom obliges with a delicate glance down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Umesh is striving too much after getting the early wicket and losing his line a bit.
Good length outside off, Williamson looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to cover.

FOUR! GRACEFUL STROKE! Back of a length outside off, Williamson stands tall and crunches it sweetly through the covers. Pierced the gap in the ring beautifully. He is such a wonderful back foot player.
Fuller on leg stump, Williamson misses the flick but the ball goes off the pads down the leg side to Dhoni.
Second slip has moved to mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, Williamson looks to drive without any footwork but is beaten.
Length ball angled in closer to off, tight lines and Williamson digs it out towards mid on.
Length ball angled in from around off, Williamson gets back and works it towards mid on.
FOUR! CLIPPED AWAY! Fuller on middle and off, Latham gets across to that one and clips it away through square leg.  Beautifully timed and that raced away to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller and outside off, Latham gets across and tucks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball angled in on off, defended well from the crease.
Fullish on off, Latham leans forward and eases it sweetly to the left of the mid on fielder. A couple added. Latham slipped after completing the first run, almost like how Kohli did early on.
Length ball outside off, angling in, Latham leaves it alone.
Full and around leg stump, Latham goes across to flick but misses. The ball brushes the pads on its way to Dhoni down the leg side.
Good length ball outside off, Williamson presses forward and defends it well.
Outside off, Latham glides it down to third man for a single.

Length ball angled in on leg stump, Latham gets across and clips it uppishly well over square leg. Clears the infield comfortably as the ball goes to the deep where Mishra pulls it back in. A brace added.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover for a single.
TOP STOP! Short and outside off, cut away by Williamson towards cover-point where Mandeep makes a dazzling diving stop to his left. Wow! Brilliant fielding as he saved a certain boundary.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
JASPRIT BUMRAH to take the other new ball.
Full and outside off, swinging away as Williamson pushes weakly at it. Gets the edge that goes on the bounce to slip and goes through him to the deep. Single added.
Good length on middle, Williamson works it through square leg for a brace.
KANE WILLIAMSON is the new man in.

OUT! WHAT A PEACH! Good length on middle, beautiful outswinger as Guptill plays inside the line of that one. Misses the line and the ball brushes the pads before disturbing the off stump. What a start for India! Guptill goes for a duck and the Kiwi chase has been jolted early. Almost a replica of Martin's dismissal in Delhi.
Length ball outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Length ball outside off, away movement again as Guptill makes a nervy leave.
Good length just around off, shaping away a bit as Guptill lets it through.

Welcome back for the chase. It should be a riveting contest considering the trend of the series. TOM LATHAM and MARTIN GUPTILL to open the batting for New Zealand. It shall be UMESH YADAV to start proceedings for India.
